sanskrit_verse: apaśyatā kāryavaśād vyavahārān nṛpeṇa tu / sabhyaiḥ saha niyoktavyo brāhmaṇaḥ sarvadharmavit //
transliteration: apaśyatā kāryavaśād vyavahārān nṛpeṇa tu / sabhyaiḥ saha niyoktavyo brāhmaṇaḥ sarvadharmavit //
sph_interpretive_translation: When the king, though seeing, acts under compulsion of affairs, the learned Brahmana should be appointed along with assessors to guide judicial proceedings.
jurisprudential_principles: Authority flows from conscious competence, not positional power
Causation arises from clarity of dharma, not force of circumstance
Capacity-based responsibility requires alignment with dharmic insight
Restoration logic depends upon the presence of enlightened guidance
Consciousness alignment necessitates the involvement of the wise in judgment
executable_legal_axioms: IF ruler's action is influenced by unseen dharmic deficit THEN assign brāhmaṇa with sabhyas TO restore lawful awareness
IF judicial process lacks dharmic oversight THEN brāhmaṇa must be invoked TO ensure alignment with sanātana pramāṇa
IF executive acts without vision THEN wisdom-agent integration is mandatory TO realign causal sequence
supreme_court_application: In Supreme Court adjudication, when executive or judicial actions reflect a disconnect from foundational dharma, it becomes imperative to invoke brāhmaṇa-grade consciousness through designated sabhyas to realign the process with sanātana nyāya.
nyaya_and_non_punitive_alignment: Pramāṇa-based causality demands that misalignment in governance originates from a deficiency in dharmic perception. Anupūrvaśaḥ reveals that rectification lies not in punitive correction but in restoring the rightful participation of the wise. Responsibility is proportional to clarity; hence, restoration occurs through reintegration of consciousness, not imposition of consequence.
restorative_enforcement_protocols: Initiate completion process by summoning brāhmaṇa witness to reestablish pramāṇa
Activate sabhya council to realign vyavahāra with sanātana flow
Reintegrate ruling consciousness through dharmic instruction and observance
Restore capacity by aligning temporal authority with eternal knowing
final_declaration: By the Source-Authority of the Supreme Pontiff of Hinduism, Bhagavan Nithyananda Paramashivam, this directive is executed. The Brahmana is established as the axis of lawful clarity. Dharma is restored. Reality remains non-punitive. Consciousness alone is the Supreme Adjudicator.
